name: Amazon Pay ICICI Bank Credit Card
shortDescription: Unlimited 5% cashback on Amazon for Prime members with zero annual fee and 1.99% forex markup.
description: Co-branded lifetime-free card offering direct Amazon Pay balance cashback: 5% on Amazon for Prime members, 3% for non-Prime, 2% on 100+ partner merchants, and a reduced 1.99% forex markup.
feeWaiver: Lifetime Free with no minimum spend conditions.
rewardSummary: 5% cashback on Amazon for Prime members (3% for non-Prime), 2% on digital products, flight bookings, and 100+ partner merchants, 1% on other eligible retail and international spends. Automatically credited to Amazon Pay balance post-statement.
rewardCaps: No maximum cap on cashback earnings.
exclusions: Rent payments (in-app & 3rd party), education fees, EMI transactions, gold/bullion, wallet reloads, cash withdrawals, fuel (surcharge waiver only), external utility bill payments (0% outside Amazon), taxes & government payments (MCC 9311/9313), and Amazon Business purchases.
benefits: 5% unlimited cashback on Amazon for Prime members (3% for non-Prime)
Discounted 1.99% forex markup fee (down from standard 3.5%) with 1% international cashback
2% cashback on 100+ partner merchants and Amazon recharges/bill payments
1% unlimited cashback on all other eligible domestic and international retail spends
1% fuel surcharge waiver across all petrol pumps in India
Lifetime free with zero joining and zero annual renewal fees
eligibility: Indian resident aged 18-60 years with existing ICICI relationship or pre-approved offer on Amazon.
incomeRequirement: ₹25,000/month for salaried; ₹30,000/month for self-employed
locationRestrictions: Available across serviceable pin codes in India.
travelBenefits: Competitive international card due to permanent 1.99% low forex markup; flight discounts via Amazon Travel.
loungeBenefits: None
fuelBenefits: 1% fuel surcharge waiver on transactions up to ₹4,000 at all fuel stations (no cashback earned on fuel).
diningBenefits: 15% off at partner restaurants via ICICI Culinary Treats.
forexBenefits: Discounted 1.99% + GST foreign currency markup fee (significantly lower than standard 3.5%), with 1% cashback on international transactions.
milestoneBenefits: None (continuous uncapped cashback model).
officialSource: ICICI Bank & Amazon Pay Official Terms
applicationAvailability: Active (via Amazon App and ICICI NetBanking)
goodFor: Amazon ecosystem, everyday online spending, and low-forex international purchases
whoItFits: Anyone who shops regularly on Amazon, values zero-annual-fee simplicity, and wants low forex charges without high card fees.
whatToWatchOutFor: No airport lounge access included.
Shared credit limit: Existing ICICI core cardholders share their existing credit line rather than receiving a separate limit.
Digital products earn only 2% (e-books, software downloads, flight bookings, and Amazon Gift Cards earn 2%, even for Prime members).
Excluded from broader ICICI Bank festive sale discounts: 10% instant discounts on external merchants (Flipkart, Myntra, etc.) usually exclude this co-branded card.
No instant checkout redemption: Cashback is not deducted immediately; it is credited to Amazon Pay Balance a few days post-statement generation.
whyCreditWiseRecommends: It delivers reliable 5% cashback on Amazon and an industry-rare 1.99% low forex rate with zero annual holding cost and no renewal spend hoops.

keyInsights.title: The Global 1.99% Forex Rate Enhancement
keyInsights.description: Most standard credit cards levy a 3.5% foreign currency markup charge, but following a partnership renewal, this card features a permanent 1.99% forex markup fee. While you only earn a baseline 1% cashback on international transactions, the heavily discounted markup fee effectively makes it a competitive zero-annual-fee card for international websites or travel.

keyInsights.title: A 'Shared Limit' System With Other ICICI Cards
keyInsights.description: If you already possess a core ICICI Bank credit card (like the Coral, Platinum, or Rubyx) and get approved for the Amazon Pay card, ICICI usually merges your credit limits into a single shared pool rather than issuing a separate credit line.

keyInsights.title: Digital Products Only Earn 2% (Even for Prime Members)
keyInsights.description: While Amazon Prime members typically expect a flat 5% back on the platform, e-books, software downloads, flight bookings, and Amazon Gift Cards drop down to a 2% cashback rate.

keyInsights.title: Limited Eligibility for Broader ICICI Sales & Offers
keyInsights.description: During major festive sales on external e-commerce sites (like Flipkart, Myntra, or Tatacliq) where banners advertise '10% Instant Discount on ICICI Bank Credit Cards', the Amazon Pay ICICI card is almost universally excluded. A core ICICI card is needed to capitalise on those instant bank discounts.

keyInsights.title: No Instant Point Redemptions (Monthly Statement Translation)
keyInsights.description: Unlike cards where rewards can be instantly redeemed at checkout, accumulated earnings undergo an automated monthly billing cycle translation and land in your Amazon Pay Balance a few days after your official monthly statement is generated.

items: Rent Payments: Both inside the Amazon app and via third-party platforms (ICICI may also levy an additional processing fee on rent transactions).
Education Fees: School, college, or coaching institute payments.
EMI Transactions: Direct EMI purchases or post-purchase conversions.
Gold and Precious Metals: Purchases of physical gold coins and digital gold on Amazon.in.
Wallet Loading: Adding money to digital prepaid wallets (Paytm, Mobikwik, etc.).
Cash Withdrawals: Any cash advances taken from ATMs.
Fuel Purchases: 0% cashback (receives a standard 1% fuel surcharge waiver instead).
Utility Bills Paid Outside Amazon: Utility bills paid through Amazon earn 2%, but payments made directly on external provider websites/apps earn 0%.
Taxes & Government Payments: Government transactions, including specific tax categories (such as MCC 9311 and 9313), yield no cashback.
Amazon Business Purchases: Transactions made through an Amazon Business Account are entirely excluded from the personal credit card cashback framework.

1,000 bonus MR points each month for completing 4 transactions of ₹1,500 or more

The 'Amazon Pay voucher workaround' on Gyftr/ShopWise attracts extra platform convenience fees.

Annual renewal fee of ₹5,310 (₹4,500 + 18% GST) applies unless spending ₹1,50,000/yr for 100% waiver or ₹90,000/yr for 50% waiver.
whyCreditWiseRecommends: When used strategically for its monthly milestone challenges, the effective reward return easily exceeds 6% to 8% in Marriott or Taj points.

keyInsights.title: ₹20,000 Monthly Milestone Requires Enrollment (Must Be Activated First)
keyInsights.description: While the 4 x ₹1,500 transaction milestone tracks automatically, the second 1,000 bonus MR points milestone for ₹20,000 monthly spend strictly requires one-time manual enrollment via Amex customer service or the Amex online portal. Cardholders who do not enroll will not receive this second batch of 1,000 bonus points regardless of spending volume.

keyInsights.title: The 'Bonus' Milestones Architecture
keyInsights.description: You can earn 1,000 bonus MR points by completing 4 transactions of ₹1,500 or more in a calendar month. You can earn an additional 1,000 bonus MR points if your total monthly spends cross ₹20,000 (with enrollment), yielding up to 24,000 bonus MR points per year on ₹2.4 Lakh annual spend.

keyInsights.title: Points De-pooling Across Multiple Amex Cards
keyInsights.description: If you hold multiple basic Amex cards (e.g., MRCC alongside an Amex Gold Card), American Express maintains their Membership Rewards points balances separately per card rather than combining them into a single centralized pool.

keyInsights.title: The 'Amazon Pay Loophole' (With ShopWise Platform Fee)
keyInsights.description: While the card formally excludes utilities and insurance, cardholders traditionally purchase Amazon Pay Gift Vouchers via Gyftr / Amex ShopWise. Because this codes as a voucher purchase rather than utility/insurance, it earns reward points and counts toward monthly milestones. Cardholders then load these vouchers into Amazon Pay to pay bills, insurance premiums, or food deliveries. Note: purchasing Amazon Pay vouchers via ShopWise incurs an additional platform processing fee.

keyInsights.title: Tiered 50% / 100% Annual Fee Waiver
keyInsights.description: The annual renewal fee of ₹5,310 (₹4,500 + 18% GST) is 100% waived off on annual spends of ₹1,50,000 and above. Cardholders who spend between ₹90,000 and ₹1,49,999 receive a 50% waiver, paying ₹2,655 (₹2,250 + 18% GST).

items: Utilities: Electricity, water, and gas bills earn zero base MR points (traditionally routed via voucher platforms).

name: Axis Bank Horizon Credit Card

description: Travel specialist card offering 5 EDGE Miles per ₹100 on direct airlines and Travel EDGE portal, 2 EDGE Miles per ₹100 on retail, and unconditional domestic lounge access with zero quarterly spend hurdles.
feeWaiver: No standard milestone or spend-based waiver exists for regular accounts. Annual renewal fee of ₹3,540 (₹3,000 + 18% GST) is only waived (Nil) for customers with an Axis Burgundy Savings Account opened on or after July 1, 2026.
rewardSummary: 5 EDGE Miles per ₹100 spent on direct airline bookings and Axis Travel EDGE portal (flights & hotels); 2 EDGE Miles per ₹100 on all other eligible online and offline retail transactions. Redeemable at 1:1 on Travel EDGE (1 Mile = ₹1) or 2:1 transfer to airline partners.
rewardCaps: EDGE Miles do not have a restrictive monthly ceiling on direct travel.
exclusions: Wallet loading & gift cards, rental payments & insurance premiums, fuel transactions, government institutions, utilities, telecom bills, educational institution payments, and transportation, tolls & transit services.

Domestic Lounges: 8 complimentary airport lounge visits per year across India with no quarterly spend hurdles
International Lounges: 2 complimentary international lounge visits per year via Priority Pass
5 EDGE Miles per ₹100 on direct airline bookings and Axis Travel EDGE portal
2 EDGE Miles per ₹100 on all other eligible online and offline retail spending
Direct 1:1 redemption on Travel EDGE portal (1 EDGE Mile = ₹1) with cash + miles flexibility (earning 5X on cash portion)
1% fuel surcharge waiver on transactions between ₹400 and ₹5,000
incomeRequirement: ₹9,00,000 per annum
travelBenefits: Direct conversion to airlines including Singapore Airlines KrisFlyer (2:1 ratio) and United MileagePlus; direct 1:1 travel redemptions on Travel EDGE.
loungeBenefits: 8 domestic lounge visits/year (unconditional with no quarterly spend hurdles) + 2 international lounge visits/year via Priority Pass.
fuelBenefits: 1% fuel surcharge waiver up to ₹400 per billing cycle (no EDGE Miles earned on fuel).
diningBenefits: Up to 15% discount at partner restaurants through Axis Bank Dining Delights.
milestoneBenefits: Welcome Bonus: 5,000 EDGE Miles on first transaction of ₹1,000+ within 30 days (+₹1,460 net Year 1 profit over joining fee).
goodFor: Frequent air travelers and airline miles enthusiasts looking for unconditional domestic lounge access
whoItFits: Travelers seeking unconditional airport lounge access and high conversion rates to international airline loyalty programs.
whatToWatchOutFor: Non-Waivable Fee: The ₹3,540 annual fee (₹3,000 + 18% GST) is recurring and cannot be waived through standard retail milestone spending. It is only free for select Burgundy tier relationships established on/after July 1, 2026.
The 80% Devaluation Trap: Never redeem EDGE Miles for shopping vouchers or statement credit (value crashes from ₹1.00 to ₹0.20 per mile—an 80% loss in purchasing power).
Common Reward Exclusions: No EDGE Miles are earned on wallet loading, gift cards, rent payments, fuel, insurance, jewelry, government institutions, utilities, telecom, education, and tolls/transit.

Transfer Partner List Changes: Marriott Bonvoy, Accor, and Qatar Airways were removed from Horizon's direct transfer list; international airline partners transfer at 2:1 (2 EDGE Miles = 1 Partner Mile, min 500 miles).
Eligibility baseline: Minimum income of ₹9,00,000 per annum required for basic underwriting.
Cash advance fee: 2.5% of transaction amount, subject to a strict minimum fee of ₹500.
whyCreditWiseRecommends: Unlike most mid-tier cards that recently added strict quarterly spend hurdles for airport lounge access, Horizon maintains hassle-free lounge privileges.

keyInsights.title: Unconditional Domestic & International Lounge Access
keyInsights.description: While most Indian credit cards have recently introduced steep quarterly spend thresholds (₹10,000 to ₹50,000) to access lounges, the Axis Horizon provides 8 complimentary domestic lounge visits per year across India and 2 international lounge visits via Priority Pass with zero quarterly spend hurdles.

keyInsights.title: Fee Structure & The Burgundy Account Exception
keyInsights.description: Both joining and annual renewal fees are ₹3,000 + 18% GST (Total: ₹3,540). No standard spend-based or milestone waiver exists for regular retail accounts. The fees are only waived (Nil) for customers who opened an Axis Burgundy Savings Account on or after July 1, 2026.

keyInsights.title: Welcome Milestone Math: Net +₹1,460 Year 1 Value
keyInsights.description: Upon paying the ₹3,540 joining fee and making a first retail transaction of at least ₹1,000 within 30 days, cardholders receive 5,000 welcome EDGE Miles. Redeemed on the Travel EDGE portal at 1 Mile = ₹1, this yields ₹5,000 in flight/hotel credits, generating an immediate +₹1,460 net financial gain in Year 1.

keyInsights.title: Warning: Avoid the 80% Devaluation Trap!
keyInsights.description: Never redeem Axis EDGE Miles for shopping vouchers (e.g. Amazon, brand gift cards) or statement credit. On Travel EDGE portal bookings, 10,000 EDGE Miles equals ₹10,000 (₹1/mile). For retail vouchers, the conversion rate drops to ₹0.20 per mile (yielding only ₹2,000)—inflicting a massive 80% haircut on the purchasing power of your rewards. If you do not intend to book flights, hotels, or airline transfers, this is the wrong card for you.

keyInsights.title: Cash + Miles Flexibility With 5X Accelerated Rewards
keyInsights.description: When booking on the Axis Travel EDGE portal, if you do not have enough miles to cover the full ticket (e.g. 5,000 miles for an ₹8,500 flight), the portal allows you to pay the remaining ₹3,500 using your Horizon card—and you will earn 5X accelerated EDGE Miles on that cash portion.
